courses.title: Algebra 1
courses.description: From one-step equations to quadratics, one short lesson at a time.

lessons.title: Square roots and completing the square

overview.summary: Build algebra from the ground up: equations, lines and functions, inequalities and systems, exponents and polynomials, and quadratics. Short lessons with worked examples and practice.
outcomes: Solve linear equations, including brackets, fractions and word problems
Graph lines and write their equations in several forms
Solve inequalities and systems of equations
Use exponent rules and scientific notation
Add, multiply and factor polynomials
Solve quadratic equations by factoring or the formula
requirements: Pre-Algebra: fractions, integers and one-step equations

courses.title: Science Basics
courses.description: Matter, energy, and the living world

overview.summary: A friendly start to science: what everything is made of and how it changes.
outcomes: Tell solids, liquids and gases apart and explain why
Describe how matter changes state
Name the parts of an atom and what a molecule is

courses.title: Programming Basics
courses.description: Learn to think in code with Python

overview.summary: Learn to think in code with Python. Start with variables and types, then teach your programs to make decisions.
outcomes: Store values in variables and change them
Tell numbers, decimals and text apart
Write if, elif and else decisions
Compare values and combine conditions

courses.title: Electronics Basics
courses.description: Voltage, current, resistance and simple circuits

overview.summary: Understand what voltage, current and resistance are, use Ohm's law, and work out simple series and parallel circuits.
outcomes: Explain voltage, current and resistance
Use Ohm's law to find any one of the three
Calculate power with P = VI
Work out series and parallel circuits

courses.title: Algebra 2
courses.description: Functions, polynomials, logarithms, sequences and the normal curve

lessons.title: Zeros and the rational root theorem

notes.title: Polynomials and complex numbers: cheat sheet

lessons.title: Compound interest and the number e
Probability basics and the normal curve

notes.title: Rational functions and sequences: cheat sheet

overview.summary: Go beyond Algebra 1 with functions, polynomials, complex numbers, exponentials, logarithms, sequences and probability. Short readings, then practice.
outcomes: Use function notation, compose and invert functions, and transform graphs
Divide, factor and solve polynomial equations, including complex solutions
Model growth and decay with exponentials and solve them with logarithms
Simplify and solve rational expressions and equations
Work with arithmetic and geometric sequences and series
Find simple probabilities and read the normal curve
requirements: Algebra 1: equations, graphs, factoring and quadratics

courses.title: Algorithms in C
courses.description: Analyse, search, sort and recurse with algorithms written in C

overview.summary: Learn how to describe and compare algorithms with big O, then write searching, sorting and recursive algorithms in C and see why some are faster.
outcomes: Count steps and describe growth with big O
Explain best, worst and average case
Write linear and binary search in C
Write bubble, selection, insertion and merge steps
Trace recursive functions and spot base cases
Explain divide and conquer and stable sorting
requirements: C Fundamentals and Arrays: loops, functions and arrays

courses.title: Arrays, Strings and Debugging
courses.description: Build, debug and work with arrays and strings in C

notes.title: How C becomes a program: cheat sheet
Strings and the command line: cheat sheet

overview.summary: See how C source becomes a program, learn to find bugs with warnings, prints, a debugger and asserts, then master arrays, strings and the command line.
outcomes: Explain preprocessing, compiling, assembling and linking
Build a program from several files with make
Debug with warnings, printf, a debugger and assert
Use one- and two-dimensional arrays safely
Handle strings with string.h, ctype.h and fgets
Read command-line arguments with argc and argv
requirements: C Fundamentals: variables, loops and functions

courses.title: Data Structures in C
courses.description: Stacks, queues, linked lists, hash tables, trees and tries, built from scratch in C

lessons.title: What is an abstract data type?
Building a hash table in C

overview.summary: Build the classic data structures in C using pointers and malloc: stacks and queues, linked lists, hash tables, binary search trees and tries, and learn when to pick each.
outcomes: Explain what an abstract data type is
Build stacks and queues in C
Create, walk, insert into and delete from linked lists
Build a hash table with separate chaining
Search, insert and traverse a binary search tree
Choose the right structure for a task
requirements: Memory and Pointers: pointers, malloc and structs

courses.title: C Fundamentals
courses.description: Learn C from scratch: variables, decisions, loops and functions.

notes.title: Functions and problem solving: cheat sheet

overview.summary: Write, compile and run your first C programs. Learn variables, types, conditions, loops and functions, then solve small problems step by step.
outcomes: Write, compile and run a C program
Use variables, types and operators correctly
Make decisions with if, else and switch
Repeat work with while and for loops
Write functions with arguments and return values
Break a small problem into steps and code it
requirements: A computer with a C compiler helps but is not required

courses.title: Memory and Pointers
courses.description: See how C stores data in bytes, then master pointers, the heap and files.

notes.title: Bytes, Hex and Addresses: cheat sheet

overview.summary: Learn how memory really works in C: bytes, hex and addresses, pointers, malloc and free, structs and files, with every example tested.
outcomes: Read bytes and hexadecimal numbers
Use addresses, pointers and pointer arithmetic
Pass pointers to functions and avoid NULL crashes
Allocate, grow and free heap memory safely
Spot leaks, use after free and overflows
Read and write text and binary files
requirements: Course C Fundamentals and Arrays: functions, arrays and strings

courses.title: Geometry
courses.description: Shapes, angles, triangles, circles and solids, with proofs and trigonometry

notes.title: Points, Lines and Angles: cheat sheet
Similarity and Right-Triangle Trig: cheat sheet
Polygons, Circles and Area: cheat sheet

overview.summary: Learn how shapes work, from points and angles to triangles, circles and solids. Each lesson is a short reading followed by practice, and every result comes with a reason.
outcomes: Find unknown angles using angle pairs and parallel lines
Use triangle rules, congruence and the Pythagorean theorem
Use similar triangles and right-triangle trigonometry
Calculate areas, circle measures and angles in polygons
Find volume and surface area of common solids
Move shapes with reflections, rotations and dilations
requirements: Algebra 1: solving equations and the coordinate plane

courses.title: Pre-Algebra
courses.description: Build the number skills you need before algebra.

lessons.title: Negative numbers and the number line

notes.title: Fractions, decimals and percents: cheat sheet
Ratios, rates and proportions: cheat sheet

overview.summary: Work with negatives, fractions, decimals, percents and ratios, then take your first steps with variables, equations and inequalities.
outcomes: Calculate with negative numbers and exponents
Follow the order of operations
Add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions
Convert between fractions, decimals and percents
Solve ratio, rate, proportion and percent problems
Solve one-step and two-step equations
requirements: Basic arithmetic: add, subtract, multiply, divide

courses.title: Precalculus
courses.description: Functions, trigonometry and the ideas that lead to calculus

overview.summary: Build the toolkit for calculus: function families, trigonometry, applications of trig and the first ideas of limits and derivatives. Short readings, then practice.
outcomes: Describe polynomial, rational, exponential and log functions
Use radians, the unit circle and trig graphs
Solve triangles with the laws of sines and cosines
Convert between polar and rectangular forms
Understand limits and the derivative as an instant rate
